## Walkthrough audio choices and voice recording

- Launch Studio can render a narrated film plus a matching music-only MP4, or choose music only without setting up a speech model.
- Kokoro narration normalizes unsupported text and retries with safe fallback narration when a page title triggers the Misaki missing-phoneme error.
- Voice recording explains how to restore browser and Windows microphone permissions and reports capture playback failures clearly.
- The download page now promotes the published 0.10.8 installers and keeps earlier installers available.
